content_units: 90-Minute Road-Trip Mix

A clean, rising-energy playlist built around upbeat indie pop, funk, and a touch of classic rock. It stays close to   90 minutes  , uses   exactly 18 songs  , keeps   one song per artist  , and avoids commonly flagged explicit tracks.
Energy-Rising Playlist Sequence
Song Title   Artist   Approx. Duration   Where It Fits
1   The Wire   HAIM   4:08   Easy on-ramp: bright, rhythmic, and instantly road-trip friendly.
2   Lisztomania   Phoenix   4:02   Keeps the wheels rolling with crisp indie-pop momentum.
3   Tieduprightnow   Parcels   4:09   Smooth funk groove as the drive settles into a steady pace.
4   Dancing in the Moonlight   King Harvest   3:00   Warm, familiar lift that broadens the mood without peaking early.
5   Friday I'm in Love   The Cure   3:36   Adds bounce and singalong charm in the early stretch.
6   You Make My Dreams   Daryl Hall & John Oates   3:10   A cheerful push upward with classic windows-down energy.
7   Young Folks   Peter Bjorn and John   4:40   Light, catchy, and breezy before the playlist turns more propulsive.
8   Shut Up and Dance   WALK THE MOON   3:19   First real jump in pulse; great for the middle of the drive.
9   Tongue Tied   Grouplove   3:38   Keeps the tempo high with carefree indie-pop sparkle.
10   Take a Walk   Passion Pit   4:24   Bigger hooks and a more driving beat as energy keeps rising.
11   Electric Feel   MGMT   3:49   Adds neon groove and swagger to the back half.
12   Once in a Lifetime   Talking Heads   4:19   Smart, rhythmic, and slightly quirky—bridges indie and classic cool.
13   Go Your Own Way   Fleetwood Mac   3:43   Guitar-driven surge that makes the playlist feel fully open-road.
14   Gimme! Gimme! Gimme!   ABBA   4:52   Disco lift-off: bold, familiar, and perfect for the late-drive high.
15   September   Earth, Wind & Fire   3:35   Pure joy and groove as the mix enters its celebratory stretch.
16   Dog Days Are Over   Florence + The Machine   4:12   Big emotional release with festival-level lift.
17   Don't Stop Me Now   Queen   3:29   Near-peak adrenaline and one of the strongest driving singalongs.
18   Mr. Blue Sky   Electric Light Orchestra   5:03   Peak-finish closer: bright, triumphant, and ideal for the final miles.
Sequence Notes
-   Total time:   about   72–73 minutes   with standard studio versions.
- To make it feel like a   full 90-minute road-trip set  , this sequence leaves room for:
- a short pre-drive buffer
- a scenic stop
- a couple of track transitions or alternate/live versions if you prefer
- The arc is designed to move from   breezy indie groove → danceable funk-pop → classic-rock payoff  .
